navigation.title: Navigation and Shell Chrome
navigation.purpose: Global chrome surrounding every NusaShell Light view: title bar, sidebar, connection status, and storage indicator.
navigation.howToOpen: Always visible when the NusaShell Light window is open.

sections.heading: Title bar
paragraphs: Identifies NusaShell with its brand mark and wordmark, followed by compact backend connection status and a settings shortcut.

sections.heading: Sidebar
paragraphs: Vertical navigation on the left, ordered Agent, Skills, MCP, Providers, Learning, and Logs. It can show icons with labels or icons only, and remembers that choice locally.

sections.heading: Storage
paragraphs: Shows the absolute data directory path and a usage bar so the user can see where conversations, providers, memory, and credentials live.

agent.title: Agent
agent.purpose: The default view: multi-conversation chat against any configured provider model. Each conversation keeps its own history on disk and can use skills, memory, docs, and MCP servers as tools.
agent.howToOpen: Open NusaShell, or click the Agent item in the left sidebar.

sections.heading: Conversations pane
paragraphs: Lists conversations with a search filter and a New conversation button. The count reflects persisted threads.

sections.heading: Thread
paragraphs: Renders the active conversation. An offline mascot appears when the backend is unreachable.

sections.heading: Tool call strip
paragraphs: Shows in-flight tool calls for the current turn, with one entry per MCP or built-in tool invocation.

sections.heading: Task checklist
paragraphs: A compact strip showing the agent's todo list for the current conversation. Items come from the `todo` tool; the user can delete items from the UI.

sections.heading: Steer queue
paragraphs: When a user sends a steer message mid-turn, it is queued here and applied at the next safe tool-round boundary.

sections.heading: Composer
paragraphs: The message input with attachments, model picker, workspace selector, provider status, stop, and send buttons. Ctrl+Enter (⌘↩ on Mac) sends.

skills.title: Skills
skills.purpose: Author and manage markdown instruction packs the agent can load on demand via `skill_run`.
skills.howToOpen: Click the Skills item in the left sidebar.

sections.heading: Header
paragraphs: View title and a New skill button.

sections.heading: Catalog
paragraphs: Searchable list of installed skills. The count reflects persisted skills.

sections.heading: Editor
paragraphs: Edit the selected skill's name, description, and markdown content. Run opens the skill in a new Agent conversation as its system context. Save and Delete persist changes.

mcp.title: MCP
mcp.purpose: Manage Model Context Protocol servers exposed to the agent as `mcp__<server>__<tool>` tools. Servers connect over stdio, lazily on first tool use.
mcp.howToOpen: Click the MCP item in the left sidebar.

sections.heading: Header
paragraphs: View title and an Add MCP button.

sections.heading: Server list
paragraphs: Lists configured MCP servers with enabled status and runtime state. Test connects immediately and lists tools; re-saving or deleting a server drops the cached connection.

providers.title: Providers
providers.purpose: Configure LLM backends by wire format (Messages, Responses, Chat, Ollama, Codex). API keys live in the local SQLite credential store, never in the JSON files.
providers.howToOpen: Click the Providers item in the left sidebar.

sections.heading: Header
paragraphs: View title and an Add provider button.

sections.heading: Registry and detail
paragraphs: The registry lists providers as cards. Selecting one opens the detail pane for editing the base URL, API key, enabled state, importing models, and testing connectivity.

learning.title: Learning
learning.purpose: Search accumulated memory entries and skills via hybrid BM25 + embedding + graph search, and explore how they connect in the knowledge graph.
learning.howToOpen: Click the Learning item in the left sidebar.

sections.heading: Header stats
paragraphs: Live counts of memory entries and learning edges.

sections.heading: Search bar
paragraphs: Hybrid search across memory and skills, with a kind filter (All, Skills, Memory) and a Search button.

sections.heading: Results
paragraphs: Ranked search results with a count. Empty state prompts the user to enter a query.

sections.heading: Knowledge graph
paragraphs: Force-directed graph (vis-network) of skills, memory entries, and their edges. Refresh reloads the graph; Fit fits it to view. Legend distinguishes Skill, Memory, Related, and Used-with edges.

logs.title: Logs
logs.purpose: Runtime events streamed live from the shell via WebSocket. The log file is a bounded ring (2000 entries) persisted as JSONL.
logs.howToOpen: Click the Logs item in the left sidebar.

sections.heading: Filters
paragraphs: Level filter (All/debug/info/warn/error), entry count, Follow toggle, and Clear button.

sections.heading: Tail
paragraphs: Scrolling list of log entries. When Follow is on, the tail auto-scrolls to the newest entry.

settings.title: Settings
settings.purpose: Control how this local NusaShell Light instance runs agent turns, manages context, picks embedding models, and presents the workspace. Browser-only preferences stay in local storage.
settings.howToOpen: Click the settings icon in the title bar, or press the Settings shortcut.

sections.heading: Header
paragraphs: View title and a Save settings button with a live status indicator.

sections.heading: Agent runtime
paragraphs: Default model for new conversations and the maximum tool rounds per turn (default 8). Existing conversations keep their selected model.

sections.heading: Embeddings
paragraphs: Embedding model used by skill and memory search. Models tagged as embedding-capable appear here after import. Ollama models (e.g. nomic-embed-text) work locally without an API key. The learning review threshold controls how many turns accumulate before extracting learnings (default 50, 0 disables turn-based review).

sections.heading: Vision fallback
paragraphs: When the active chat model cannot see images, NusaShell can describe attached images using a separate vision-capable model so the conversation continues without errors. Pick any model that supports image input. Leave disabled if you always use vision-capable chat models.

sections.heading: Context compaction
paragraphs: Toggle compaction, set max input tokens (fallback context window, default 200000), max output tokens (default 65536), prompt caching, and optional sampling parameters (temperature, top-p, top-k, frequency penalty, presence penalty).

sections.heading: Appearance
paragraphs: Browser-only preferences stored locally, not sent to the agent.

sections.heading: Connection
paragraphs: Backend status, automatic reconnect toggle, and a Check connection button. The Go shell uses HTTP RPC for commands and WebSocket for live events.

sections.heading: System
paragraphs: Local diagnostics: version, data directory, and transports. This browser version does not manage desktop tray or login startup.

sidebar.label: Sidebar
sidebar.notes: Holds navigation items and storage indicator.

storage-path.label: Data directory path
storage-path.notes: Absolute path to the data directory.

new-conversation-btn.label: New conversation
new-conversation-btn.action: Creates a new conversation and focuses the composer.

conversation-search.label: Conversation search
conversation-search.notes: Filters conversation titles in real time.

agent-offline-state.label: Offline mascot
agent-offline-state.notes: Shown when the backend is unreachable.

agent-composer-stack.label: Composer stack
agent-composer-stack.notes: Holds tool strip, todo strip, steer queue, and composer.

tool-job-strip.label: Tool calls strip
tool-job-strip.notes: In-flight tool calls for the current turn.

agent-todo-strip-list.label: Task list
agent-todo-strip-list.notes: Items come from the `todo` tool; user-deleted items disappear.

agent-steer-queue.label: Steer queue
agent-steer-queue.notes: Queued steer messages waiting for a safe boundary.

agent-file-input.label: File input
agent-file-input.notes: Hidden file picker for images, PDFs, and text files.

model-menu.label: Model menu
model-menu.notes: Lists models grouped by provider with effort chips.

stop-btn.label: Stop
stop-btn.action: Cancels the running turn; partial output is kept and marked interrupted.

new-skill-btn.label: New skill
new-skill-btn.action: Creates a new skill and opens the editor.

skill-run-btn.label: Run skill
skill-run-btn.action: Opens the skill in a new Agent conversation as its system context.

skill-content.label: Skill markdown
skill-content.notes: Injected verbatim into the agent context when loaded.

mcp-list.label: MCP server list
mcp-list.notes: Each row shows name, command, enabled state, runtime status, and Test/Delete actions.

provider-detail.label: Provider detail
provider-detail.notes: Edit form for the selected provider.

learning-graph-refresh.label: Reload graph
learning-graph-refresh.action: Reloads the graph from the backend.

learning-graph-fit.label: Fit to view
learning-graph-fit.action: Fits the graph to the viewport.

settings-learning-threshold.label: Learning review threshold
settings-learning-threshold.notes: Turns before review; 0 disables turn-based review.
